title: Val Marie Campground

services.name: Val Marie Campground
services.desc: Come and stay at our cozy, well maintained campground in the Village of Val Marie. Sites are beautifully grassed with lots of trees providing plenty of shade. Our washrooms and showers are wheelchair accessible and very clean. On-site sani-dump and central water tap are available for use, and the sites are serviced with electricity. We have also recently added a Spray Park to our campground! So, don’t forget your bathing suit and enjoy this service on those hot summer

explain.meaning: A guided horseback ride along trails, mostly at walking pace.
